The bison on the right is in the foreground, facing left, showing its head, shoulder hump, and front legs. The bison on the left is slightly behind, also facing left, partially obscured by the foreground bison. Both exhibit characteristic shaggy dark brown fur, prominent shoulder humps, and short curved horns.
